review.explanation: The mention 蘇峻 appears in the main text: '蘇峻時遇害' (killed during Su Jun's rebellion). The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-5762ff56c45eca9eeb43 from data/people.json provides the canonical name 蘇峻. The main text explicitly names 蘇峻 as the rebel during whose uprising the child was killed. This is a direct full-name reference with clear historical context matching the well-known Su Jun. The identity is specifically supported by the main text evidence.

The mention 温太真 appears in the main text: '温太真嘗隱幔怛之' (Wen Taizhen once hid behind a curtain to startle him). The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-2fda6b1c7926990013d9 from data/aliases.json shows 温太真 as an alias for 温嶠. The main text describes Wen Taizhen performing the specific action of startling the child, which is consistent with the historical Wen Qiao (温嶠), courtesy name 太真. The alias registry evidence directly supports this identification.

The mention 元規 appears in the main text: '或云見阿恭知元規非假' (some say seeing A Gong one knows Yuan Gui was not feigning). The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-d21b97b9cf2f93f364a8 from data/aliases.json shows 元規 as the courtesy name of 庾亮. The main text context is about Yu Liang (庾太尉/亮) and his son, and the final line '知元規非假' refers to knowing that Yuan Gui (Yu Liang) was genuine. The alias registry directly maps 元規 to 庾亮, and the historical context of this story about Yu Liang's son supports this identification.

The mention 亮 (abbreviated form of 庾亮) appears in the main text: '論者謂不減亮' (commentators said [the child] was not inferior to Liang). The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-0191ce26820545ee508b from hng2c1-shishuo-29-jianshe-008-main shows 庾太尉 as a reference to 庾亮. The main text opens with 庾太尉 and later uses 亮 as the abbreviated personal name, clearly coreferring to the same person. The story is about Yu Liang's son, and the comparison '不減亮' compares the son to his father Yu Liang. The coreference with 庾太尉 in the same text is explicit.

The mention 庾太尉 is an office title reference. The main text explicitly states '庾太尉風儀偉長...時人皆以爲假亮' where 亮 is used as the personal name of the same person, confirming 庾太尉 = 庾亮. The text also later uses 元規 (庾亮's courtesy name) in the same passage. The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-3921bf4152ad188bbdf0 directly matches 庾太尉 to 庾亮, and the main text confirms this identification through the use of 亮 and 元規 for the same individual.

The mention 君侯 is an honorific used by the child to address 温太真. The main text reads '温太真嘗隱幔怛之此兒神色恬然乃徐跪曰君侯何以爲此' — the child addresses 温太真 as 君侯. The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-b525dc41479c3aedf857 shows 温太真 as the matched surface for 温嶠. The coreference between 君侯 and 温太真 is directly supported by the main text context where the child responds to 温太真.

The mention 元規 is 庾亮's courtesy name. The main text states '或云見阿恭知元規非假' where 元規 refers to 庾亮 (the father of 阿恭/庾會). The Liu annotation sfh1-ev-06-yaliang-017-liu-annotation-001 confirms the genealogical context: 尉亮長子 refers to 庾亮's eldest son 庾會. The main text also uses 亮 as the personal name for the same person (庾太尉...時人皆以爲假亮), confirming 元規 = 亮 = 庾太尉 = 庾亮. The candidate evidence sfh1-candidate-evidence-8281d16e4502b7cbd129 shows 元規 as 庾亮's courtesy name in the alias registry.

assertions.interpretation: The annotation indicates the year (咸和六年) when 庾會 was killed, providing the temporal anchor for the event of his death.
The reign era 咸和 (326–334) is given in the 庾氏譜 annotation, anchoring the year of 庾會's death within this reign period.
庾會 was nineteen years old at the time of his death, giving his age at the fatal event.
庾亮's eldest son was only a few years old when he displayed his composed nature, an earlier phase of his childhood.
The son was killed during the 蘇峻 rebellion, providing the historical event context for his death.
At the time, people thought 庾亮's dignified demeanor was feigned — a contemporary background perception preceding the child's demonstration of innate nature.
Commentators later judged that the child was no less impressive than 庾亮 himself, a retrospective assessment following the observed events.
